description: This file implements the Azure AI OCR transformation class, extending the MistralOCRConfig. It provides methods for environment validation, URL to data URI conversion (synchronously and asynchronously), and transforming OCR requests by converting URLs within documents to base64 data URIs suitable for Azure AI OCR API.

classes.name: AzureAIOCRConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for Azure AI OCR that inherits from MistralOCRConfig. It handles environment validation, URL data URI conversions, and request transformations specific to Azure AI OCR API.

methods.name: Dict validate_environment( self, headers: Dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, litellm_params: Optional[dict] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Validates required environment variables and builds headers with authentication for Azure AI OCR.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: Optional[dict] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API endpoint URL for Azure AI OCR based on the provided api_base.

methods.name: str _convert_url_to_data_uri_sync(self, url: str)
methods.description: Synchronously converts a URL into a base64 data URI for documents/images.

methods.name: str _convert_url_to_data_uri_async(self, url: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously converts a URL into a base64 data URI for documents/images.

methods.name: OCRRequestData transform_ocr_request( self, model: str, document: DocumentType, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms the OCR request by converting URLs in the document to base64 data URIs synchronously.

methods.name: OCRRequestData async_transform_ocr_request( self, model: str, document: DocumentType, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms the OCR request by converting URLs in the document to base64 data URIs asynchronously.
